name: How much does window frame repair typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does window frame repair typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window frame repair varies significantly based on the extent of the damage, the type of material, and the number of windows affected. Minor repairs might involve simple sealing or patching, while extensive rot or structural issues will require more significant labor and materials. We provide a detailed estimate after an on-site evaluation to ensure transparency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on damage extent, material type, and number of windows; minor repairs are less expensive than extensive structural issues.
